text.p: --Hambrecht and Quist analyst Hank Wilson said he upgraded Hasbro Inc to a buy from a hold, citing a better than expected performance by Star Wars Special Edition and "strong offerings" in line for 1997.

--Wilson said he expects Hasbro's price/earnings multiple will expand to 18 times earnings from 15 times over the next 12 months. He said he expects the stock to reach its target price of $57 per share over the next 12 months. The stock last traded at 42-1/2.

--The Star Wars Special Ediction line of toys is being marketed in line with the re-release of the Star Wars Trilogy of films. Wilson said that due to the "unbelievable success" of the Star Wars films, he believes Hasbro's license for the toys could be extended beyond 1997.
